findings.title: An unlisted short occurrence donates its lane to a later unobserved same-track occurrence
findings.test_name: independent: unlisted short occurrence must not donate its lane to a later unobserved repeat
repro: Onboard200tracks180s; play station; advance10s and force sync. Skip then advance1s and sync: next track id T00000000000000000001k is observed and lane fresh noted.
Advance5s, skip under30s, advance1s/sync. Provider legitimately has no recently-played entry for that short occurrence; old lane note remains.
Advance60s; controlled SQLite replacement-deck fixture updates writtenAt and same id kind=favorite. This is an explicit valid replacement fixture, not a claim of live provider publication.
FakeSpotify plays same id from replacement station context for45s entirely between app observations, then skips; sync.
Stored later history lane is fresh, borrowed from the old short occurrence; expected null for this unobserved occurrence, never old fresh.
findings.cause: laneFor matches only station,id,seenAt before listing and up to2days; lane notes do not bind start/end/observed occurrence and skipped-unlisted notes are never retired on observed departure.
findings.impact: Verlauf falsely claims why this very play occurred; later same-ID play borrows different occurrence provenance. Listening counts/order remain intact in this trace.
findings.repair_direction: Bind lane notes to actual observed occurrence boundaries and match listing only within supported occurrence evidence; retire/close short departed notes or return conservative null on ambiguity. Do not infer song completion from wall time.
regression_required: Observed short skip under30s/no provider listing followed by same-ID unobserved replay from changed deck
Repeated same-ID occurrences across pause/restart and late listings

findings.title: A nullable device id is treated as confirmed guest-device exit and guest music contaminates owner memory
repro: ConfigurePartyid as guest; stationplay on Party; advance10s, force sync, guestactive true.

Wrap FakeSpotify GET /me/player 200 response to set only device.id=null (documented nullable provider field). Preserve device name/type, track, progress, is_playing=true and actual fake player stillParty.
Advance10s, force sync. Actual logs claim guest device stopped and guestactive false despite no observed stop or identified non-guest device.
Actual still-Party song plays another35s then is skipped; force sync. Actual SQL ignored=0; expected1 while within prior confirmed15min guest hold.
findings.cause: ID-only matching correctly avoids name collisions, but every nonmatch includes unknown/null identity and unconditionally clears last/tail through endDevicePeriod. Unknown playing identity becomes invented confirmed owner exit.
findings.impact: Party-only listening is counted as owner listening; violates protected guest/history/account-taste behavior and truthful observed-state semantics.
findings.repair_direction: Distinguish unknown playing device identity from observed different non-guest ID/no-player evidence. Preserve bounded prior confirmed guest uncertainty state without extending indefinitely or selecting by ambiguous name.
regression_required: Nullable deviceid while stillplaying on confirmed guest device, continued song listing ignored
Known owner ID confirmed exit and same-name/different-ID collision checks stayPASS
No-player, 429, missingdevice and bounded expiry/manualguest removal cases

findings.title: Optional genre AI blocks playback and every other listener operation while waiting for external inference
findings.preconditions: Authenticated onboarded listener with nonempty imported artist summary and Workers AI configured; playback active.
reproduction: Use actual UserHub class, stubbing only cloudflare:workers DurableObject constructor for Node, and inject real HubCore/FakeSpotify harness.
Start u.estimateGenres(sessionEpoch) with AI run Promise held unresolved.
After AI is entered call u.playerAction(epoch,pause).
After100ms pause still unresolved and provider transport untouched. Release AI promise; estimate completes, then pause succeeds.
findings.expected: Optional profile inference must not own the account-wide player/state lock for an unbounded remote wait; owner pause/device actions and observation must remain responsive, with fenced publication of the eventual estimate.
findings.actual: estimateGenres uses session→exclusive and awaits the entire provider call. All later operations queue behind it. Workers AI path has no deadline; installed Anthropic SDK constructor here uses defaults timeout10minutes and maxRetries2 (source-read, not a live latency measurement).
findings.repair_direction: Move optional inference off critical per-listener lock with bounded attempt/publish lifecycle, retain epoch/account/generation fencing and cache/coalescing; add bounded provider timeout/retry policy.
required_regressions: AI timeout/failure and eventual stale completion
Concurrent requests coalesce; newer import/account state prevents stale publication

findings.title: Six-hour genre gate disappears on provider failures/refusals and permits immediate repeated paid requests
reproduction: Store valid imported summary with positive artist minutes.
Use Workers AI returning response refused (unusable JSON).
Call estimateGenres three times at unchanged clock, restarting HubCore between attempts.
findings.expected: Documented at-most-every-six-hours inference/request policy must cover failed or refused attempts durably, preserve old successful result and provide honest retry timing.
findings.actual: Three AI calls occur (test expected1, observed3). Only successful genre_estimate.at is stored. No successful estimate, or an expired previous result, leaves each retry immediately eligible; persists across restart.
findings.repair_direction: Store bounded durable attempt deadline before issuing inference, with concurrency protection; retain previous result, distinguish attempt/retry from successful-estimate age and provider429 if provided.
required_regressions: Expired successful estimate then repeated failures
